name: Shoreline creek (MAINTAINED_DRAIN) + narrow-creek bank paint
notes: Shoreline Studio's creek preset MAINTAINED_DRAIN (cross-channel cut that keeps the fall, deterministic from the parent id and the recipe seed), then golfmap-creek-narrow's bank paint in golfmap colours: the blends joined in for good (red = grass lip), rings 1+ dirt with half of ring 1 flecked back to grass, rings 2+ bed.
